subject: maths
title: Odd, even and sharing
summary: Make pairs on a ten frame, spot odd and even, and share onto two plates.

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 picks a pair group of 8. Q2 sees 10 in pairs. Q3 shares 10. Q4 spots odd 7. Q5 shares 8. Q6 sees 2 pairs in 4. Q7 spots odd 9. Q8 types half of 6. Q9 picks even 10. Q10 orders 2, 6, 10.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy pairs small numbers and shares 4, 6 and 8 with two-colour parts. Medium uses numbers to 10 and a one-colour frame. Hard mixes odd leftover, sharing and reverse thinking with no picture that gives the share away. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
